action_items: Staff page: after StaffFormModal save success, re-fetch /api/staff/leaderboard so the newly-set monthly_target and target_bonus appear without a full-page reload. E.g., expose loadLeaderboard() from StaffLeaderboard via ref/context or re-mount via key={staffVersion} that bumps after save.
critical_code_review_comments: React hydration warning: <option> in MiraDayOffer.jsx line 190 and InvoiceHeader.jsx line 25 contains a <span data-ve-dynamic> child — <option> cannot have a <span> child in HTML. Same pattern is spammed on every page render (Dashboard, POS). Should be fixed by inlining the dynamic value directly (e.g., {p.label}) without the ve-dynamic wrapper.

React warning: `value` prop on `<input>` is null in StaffFormModal (monthly_target / target_commission_pct default to null on staff records without a target). Coerce with `?? ''` when hydrating form state.

WalletDialog.jsx line 15/16 fires 2 API calls unconditionally on every render pass triggered by load; consider moving the plans fetch to the parent or using a single hook that shares state across dialog opens.

PIN modal UX: PUT /api/staff/{id} initially returns 403 OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED and the code retries after PIN; consider pre-checking Owner PIN unlock state when the Edit modal opens (like ComplaintsPanel does) so the user doesn't briefly see a failed save toast before the PIN prompt.
POS guest search returns duplicate 'Norm Test' rows; consider showing phone/email in the dropdown for disambiguation.
